project_name: Grace Treasury - Church Financial Management System
theme: Light Theme Default with Soft Warm Sanctuary Palette and Dark Mode Toggle
archetype: Organic & Earthy + High Precision Non-Profit Financial Ledger

typography.font_family_body: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-serif font-semibold text-slate-900 tracking-tight
hierarchy.caption_label: text-xs font-sans font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-8
layout_and_spacing.header_nav: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5E0D8] px-4 sm:px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white border border-[#E5E0D8] rounded-xl shadow-xs hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 p-5 sm:p-6

navigation_bar.description: Top fixed header with Church Logo/Name, Treasurer identity badge, primary tabs (Dashboard, Transactions, Monthly Report, Settings), and Quick Entry CTA.

bank_accounts_overview.description: Cards displaying the 3 primary bank accounts (Operating Checking, Building Savings, Memorial/Missions Escrow) with ability to add/edit/manage accounts.
features: Quick filter link to transactions for this account

fund_accounting_tracker.description: Fund balances breakdown (General Fund, Building Fund, Missions & Outreach, Youth Ministry, Benevolence, Choir/Music). Shows restricted vs unrestricted funds.

transaction_form_modal.description: Modal or slide-over drawer for recording Income, Expense, or Transfer.
fields: Payee / Vendor / Contributor (Select + Auto-suggest + Add New)
Category / Chart of Accounts (Tithe, Donation, Utility, Maintenance, Staff Salary, Literature)

transactions_table.description: Searchable, filterable ledger with instant keyword search, date range filter, account filter, fund filter, category filter, and check number filter.

monthly_treasurer_report.description: Professional report page mimicking traditional Baptist church monthly business meeting treasury statements.
controls: Preset date ranges (This Month, Last Month, YTD, Custom)
sections: Header: Church Name, Report Title, Date Range, Treasurer Name
Section 1: Bank Accounts Cash Balance Summary (Beginning Balance, Total Receipts, Total Disbursements, Ending Balance)
Section 2: Fund Balances Statement (Fund Name, Beginning, Receipts, Disbursements, Transfers, Ending Balance)
Section 3: Income & Expense Breakdown by Category vs Annual Budget
Footer: Treasurer Signature & Date line for Church Business Meeting Minutes

settings_panel.description: Full administrative control center split into 6 structured tabs.

tabs.label: Church Funds
tabs.description: Manage General, Building, Missions, Youth, Benevolence funds

tabs.label: Payees & Vendors
tabs.description: Vendor directory and default category mappings

tabs.label: Church Info & Branding
tabs.description: Church name, logo upload, meeting day

rules: Hide top navbar, sidebar, buttons, filter bars, pagination controls, and action icons (use class `.no-print` or `print:hidden`).
Set background to white (#FFFFFF) and text to dark black (#000000) for highest crispness on paper.
Ensure clean standard 0.5in / 12mm margins suitable for US Letter paper size.
Use crisp table borders (border-collapse, border 1px solid #333).
Display accounting double-underline under final totals (`border-b-4 border-double border-black`).
Force page breaks before major report sections if long (`page-break-inside: avoid`).
Include a dedicated signature block at the bottom: 'Respectfully submitted, _______________________ (Treasurer)  Date: _________'.

data_testid_convention.pattern: kebab-case description based on function and role

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: This codebase uses .js files (not .tsx). Do NOT use TypeScript annotations or interfaces inside component files.
Do NOT use pure transparent background on sticky headers, dropdowns, or modals. Always use solid or blurred backdrop (#FDFBF7 or rgba(253, 251, 247, 0.95)).
Use Sonner (`import { toast } from 'sonner'`) for user feedback notifications (e.g. Transaction saved, Report exported, Bank account added).
Ensure every financial table uses `font-mono` or `tabular-nums` for clean vertical decimal alignment.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes as specified in the testId conventions.
Ensure complete responsive support for desktop, laptop, and tablet screens.
The Monthly Treasurer's Report view MUST render cleanly on-screen and print impeccably on standard Letter paper using print styles.
